title: PILs filed before Delhi High Court on police atrocities against Jantar Mantar protestors
description: Two public interest litigation petitions have been filed before the Delhi High Court flagging the police action against Jantar Mantar protesters in Delhi.The matter was was mentioned on Wednesday before a Bench of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia for urgent listing."This incident has shaken the conscience of the nation," a lawyer appearing for the petitioners said.The Court then agreed to hear the case today.Earlier on Tuesday as well, a similar mentioning was made.
